bull.label: Bull - AI/infra capex supercycle continues
bull.method: Average of the multiples-method and PEG-method bull price targets (local currency), current FX.

base.label: Base - trend growth, no re-rating
base.method: Current price compounded at the stock's own forward EPS growth rate; multiple held flat, current FX.

bear.label: Bear - growth disappoints, multiples compress
bear.method: Average of the multiples-method and PEG-method bear price targets (local currency), current FX.

rate_shock.label: Rate shock - PEG de-rates to sector peer median
rate_shock.method: PEG-method bull multiple compresses to the sector peer median PEG (growth stops earning a premium), current FX.

fx_headwind.label: FX headwind - EUR +15% vs USD/GBP/CHF
fx_headwind.method: Base-case local-currency price, converted at a shocked FX rate (EUR appreciates 15% vs non-EUR currencies).
